metadata.description: Wire format for search-mode `GET /v1/packages?q=...`: scored package hits assembled by the live server. Read both by `crates/vibe-registry/src/index_client/wire.rs` (`SearchResults`, `SearchHit`) and raw `curl | jq` consumers. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/packages.rs` (`SearchResponse`, `SearchHit`, `list_or_search`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/package_search_response/`.
Always `search` for this response.
The search query as supplied by the caller. This field is consumed by the vibe-registry client view.
How many hits survived offset and limit. The writer and client view use usize; uint32 is JTD's widest exact unsigned integer.
The selected scored hit list. Required: a matchless query writes an empty array, never an absent key.
One scored package hit. Every field consumed by `index_client/wire.rs::SearchHit` is present; `group` and `unavailable` are server additions tolerated by that view.
The scored version's installable kind.
The hit package's reverse-FQDN group qualifier.
The hit package's bare name.
The version chosen for the hit, or null when absent. The key is always present and is consumed by the client view.
The token-overlap relevance score consumed by the client view.
Query tokens that matched this package, consumed by the client view. Required even when empty.
The scored version's description, or null; consumed by the client view and always present.
Refused versions of the hit package, absent when none exist.
One package version this build refuses and the recovery recipe, mirroring `crates/vibe-index/src/index/quarantine.rs::Unavailable`.
The refused version's group qualifier.
The refused version's bare package name.
The refused semantic version.
Reader capabilities unknown to this build, in record order.
The generated explanation and fix surface for the refusal.
